description: Build a bounded review workflow for deciding whether a synthetic text classifier's proposed update deserves a further evaluation round. The task is to support that decision from supplied results and limited adjudication, without declaring deployment readiness.
valued_outcome: Produce a reproducible advance, reject or unresolved decision under the supplied acceptance rule, identify affected slices, and account for every adjudication used.
hard_constraints: Use only supplied records and labels; no outside examples.
Apply the stated acceptance rule without changing thresholds.
At most sixteen disputed labels may be adjudicated.
Report uncertainty when the adjudication limit prevents a supported decision.
resources: Eighty synthetic examples with baseline and candidate predictions, provisional labels and one of four slice identifiers.
A supplied rule: advance only if total correct predictions improve by at least four and no slice loses more than two.
A sealed adjudication table for twenty-four flagged labels, accessible one selected row at a time.
Spreadsheet or local script environment and seventy minutes of analyst time.
observations: Against provisional labels, the candidate gains six correct predictions overall.
One slice loses two and contains nine flagged labels.
Awkward observation: the slice with the largest apparent improvement also contains the most disagreements between the two supplied provisional annotators.

known_parent_functions.function: A confusion table counts prediction outcomes against labels.
known_parent_functions.operating_path: Group paired prediction and label values into count cells.

known_parent_functions.function: A sampling log records why particular items were inspected.
known_parent_functions.operating_path: Associate selected record identifiers with selection criteria and results.

adverse_disturbance: Withhold adjudication for four flagged rows selected before either workflow runs; attempted access still consumes no adjudication allowance but must be logged.
probe_resources: Two matched copies of the dataset with independently reset sixteen-row allowances.
One sealed full-label decision key, opened after both variant reports are frozen, plus an adjudication and time log.
